primaryRawText:
V550 GOLD I MULTI
MPZ-5501-AFAG
MAKE IT DIGITAL
The V Gold i was created with two main design principles in
mind. The first was fundamental high quality PSU design.
Cooler Master wanted to deliver a top-tier PSU that would
provide all the bells and whistles a modern user might want
or need for their high-end system. The second principle was
control. As technology advances, digital solutions make it
possible to monitor and customize more aspects of PC
hardware. This now includes power supplies. With its digital
infrastructure, V Gold i allows users to observe and alter
performance in real time via Cooler Master's own
MasterPlus+ free software.
FEATURES SPECIFICATIONS
Semi-Digital Platform : The digital platform connects directly to the
motherboard via included USB 3.0 wire, allowing software based
performance monitoring and customization.
80 PLUS Gold Certified : This certification guarantees a minimum
typical efficiency of 90% under normal operating conditions.
Quiet 135mm Fan : The 135mm silent fan creates less friction,
making it great for low RPM operations while delivering quiet
cooling performance.
Smart Thermal Control Mode : Under the premise of PSU
functioning and reliability normally. Customize the FAN curve mode
through Masterplus+.
Full Modular Cable Management : Full modular cables reduce
clutter, increase airflow, and improve overall efficiency and thermal
performance.
10 Year Warranty : This unit comes with a standard limited
manufacturing warranty of 10 years from the date of purchase.
